items.detail: GOV.UK guidance (reviewed 2 October 2026) states under the heading 'Register your property (not yet in force)': 'The UK government is introducing a mandatory national registration scheme for short-term lets in England. It is expected to begin in March 2027.' There is currently no register to join, no portal, no published fee and no exact start date. The March 2027 date is an expectation, not a fixed statutory date — the timetable has already moved before (the May 2026 version of the page said 'expected to begin in 2026'). Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy told the House of Commons on 3 September 2026 that the register would be 'up and running in full by March' (March 2027). Known conclusion (expected March 2027 start, not yet open) confirmed against the official GOV.UK guidance, current 2 October 2026 version.
items.detail_zh: GOV.UK 指南（2026 年 10 月 2 日复核）在“注册您的物业（尚未生效）”标题下写明：“英国政府正在为英格兰短租引入强制性全国注册制度，预计于 2027 年 3 月开始。”目前没有可加入的注册制度，没有门户网站，未公布费用，也没有确切开始日期。2027 年 3 月是预期时间，不是固定法定期限——时间表此前已推迟过（2026 年 5 月版页面写的是“预计于 2026 年开始”）。文化大臣 Lisa Nandy 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日在下议院表示注册制度将于“3 月前全面运行”（即 2027 年 3 月）。已知结论（预计 2027 年 3 月开始、当前未开放）已对照 GOV.UK 官方指南 2026-10-02 版证实。

items.detail: Section 228 of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023 (in force 26 December 2023) requires the Secretary of State to make regulations requiring or permitting the registration of specified short-term rental properties in England. The Act allows the regulations to set fees, civil penalties and a ban on advertising unregistered lets, but none of these has been decided. As of mid-October 2026 no implementing statutory instrument had been published on legislation.gov.uk.
items.detail_zh: 《2023 年升级与重建法》第 228 条（2023 年 12 月 26 日生效）要求国务大臣制定法规，要求或允许英格兰特定短租物业注册。该法允许法规设定费用、民事罚款及禁止广告未注册房源，但均未决定。截至 2026 年 10 月中旬，legislation.gov.uk 上尚未公布实施性法规。

items.detail: Under s.25 of the Greater London Council (General Powers) Act 1973, using residential premises in Greater London as temporary sleeping accommodation is a material change of use requiring planning permission. Section 44 of the Deregulation Act 2015 (in force 26 May 2015) inserted s.25A, under which the use is NOT a material change of use if two conditions are both met: (1) total nights of such use in the same calendar year does not exceed 90; and (2) the person providing the accommodation was liable to pay council tax at the premises for each of those nights. The 90-night count attaches to the premises, not the operator, and resets on 1 January. 'Temporary sleeping accommodation' means accommodation occupied by the same person for fewer than 90 consecutive nights. Known conclusion (Greater London 90-day cap) confirmed against the statute text on legislation.gov.uk.
items.detail_zh: 根据《1973 年大伦敦议会（一般权力）法》第 25 条，在大伦敦将住宅用作临时住宿属于实质性用途变更，须取得规划许可。《2015 年放松管制法》第 44 条（2015 年 5 月 26 日生效）新增第 25A 条：同时满足两个条件时不构成实质性用途变更：(1) 同一公历年内此类使用总晚数不超过 90 晚；(2) 提供住宿的人在每一晚均为该物业的市政税纳税人。90 晚计数按物业而非按经营者计算，每年 1 月 1 日重置。“临时住宿”指同一人连续入住少于 90 晚的住宿。已知结论（大伦敦 90 天上限）已对照 legislation.gov.uk 法条原文证实。
items.source_name: legislation.gov.uk — Deregulation Act 2015, s.44 (inserting s.25A into the Greater London Council (General Powers) Act 1973)
items.title: Greater London 90-night cap (plus council tax condition)
items.value: Up to 90 nights per calendar year without planning permission, provided the provider is liable for council tax at the premises

items.detail: If either s.25A condition fails — more than 90 nights in a calendar year, or the provider is not liable for council tax at the premises — the use is a material change of use and planning permission from the London borough is required. Local planning authorities also hold a reserve power (s.25B) to direct that the 90-night exception does not apply to particular premises or areas.
items.detail_zh: 任一第 25A 条条件不满足——同一公历年超过 90 晚，或提供住宿的人不是该物业市政税纳税人——即构成实质性用途变更，须向伦敦自治市申请规划许可。地方规划当局另有保留权力（第 25B 条），可指令 90 晚例外不适用于特定物业或区域。
items.title: Beyond 90 nights in Greater London: planning permission required
items.value: Planning permission for a material change of use is required

items.detail: GOV.UK guidance (reviewed 2 October 2026): 'Your local planning authority will decide whether you need planning permission. This is based on how the property is used for short-term letting and its impact on neighbours and the local area. You should contact your council to confirm whether you need planning permission.' There is no national night threshold outside Greater London; whether letting amounts to a material change of use is decided case by case. Known conclusion (planning decided by the local authority case by case) confirmed against the official GOV.UK guidance.
items.detail_zh: GOV.UK 指南（2026 年 10 月 2 日复核）：“您的地方规划当局将决定您是否需要规划许可。这取决于物业用于短租的方式及其对邻居和当地社区的影响。您应联系议会确认是否需要规划许可。”大伦敦以外没有全国统一的晚数阈值；短租是否构成实质性用途变更由地方当局逐案判断。已知结论（规划由地方当局个案决定）已对照 GOV.UK 官方指南证实。
items.source_name: GOV.UK — Letting out a self-catering holiday home in England: rules and regulations (reviewed 2 Oct 2026)
items.title: Planning permission decided by the local planning authority, case by case
items.value: Local planning authority decides; no national threshold outside Greater London

items.detail: A new C5 use class for short-term lets was consulted on in 2023 (consultation closed 7 June 2023) but is not law: no statutory instrument amending the Use Classes Order to insert C5 has been laid, and GOV.UK still says it is analysing the feedback (checked 30 October 2026). Do not confuse with Wales, where C5 means a second home and C6 is the short-term let class.
items.detail_zh: 为短租新设 C5 用途分类曾于 2023 年咨询（2023 年 6 月 7 日截止），但不是法律：尚未有修订《用途分类令》以纳入 C5 的法规出台，GOV.UK 仍表示在分析反馈（2026 年 10 月 30 日核查）。不要与威尔士混淆：威尔士的 C5 指第二套住房，C6 才是短租分类。
items.source_name: UK Short-Let Rules Tracker — Do I Need Planning Permission for a Holiday Let? (England 2026), checked 30 Oct 2026
items.title: C5 short-term-let use class: proposal only, not in force

items.detail: Since 1 April 2023, a self-catering property in England is rated for business rates (rather than council tax) where it was available to let commercially for 140 nights in a 12-month period, actually let commercially for 70 nights in that period, and the owner intends to keep it available for at least 140 nights in the next year (GOV.UK business rates guidance, updated 1 April 2026). This is a much lower bar than Wales (252/182 days).
items.detail_zh: 自 2023 年 4 月 1 日起，英格兰自助式度假屋在以下情况下缴营业税（而非市政税）：12 个月内可商业出租 140 晚、实际商业出租 70 晚，且业主打算下一年继续可出租至少 140 晚（GOV.UK 营业税指南，2026 年 4 月 1 日更新）。门槛远低于威尔士（252/182 天）。
items.source_name: UK Short-Let Rules for Hosts (citing GOV.UK, business rates for a self-catering property in England, updated 1 Apr 2026)
items.title: Self-catering business rates tests: 140 nights available, 70 nights let
items.value: Available ≥140 nights and actually let ≥70 nights in 12 months

items.detail: GOV.UK guidance (reviewed 2 October 2026): 'The government abolished the Furnished Holiday Let (FHL) tax regime on 6 April 2025. From the 2025 to 2026 tax year onwards, all income from short-term holiday accommodation and self-catering properties is taxed under usual residential landlord rules. The previous FHL tax reliefs no longer apply.' (Corporation tax: from 1 April 2025.)
items.detail_zh: GOV.UK 指南（2026 年 10 月 2 日复核）：“政府已于 2025 年 4 月 6 日废除带家具度假出租（FHL）税收制度。自 2025 至 2026 纳税年度起，所有短期度假住宿和自助式物业收入均按普通住宅房东规则征税，此前的 FHL 税收减免不再适用。”（公司税：自 2025 年 4 月 1 日起。）

items.title: Furnished Holiday Lettings tax regime abolished 6 April 2025
items.value: FHL regime abolished; income taxed under usual residential landlord rules
